basics.headline: Registered Nurse — Intensive Care
basics.summary: Registered nurse with 12 years in intensive and post-operative care. Shift lead for a 24-bed unit, responsible for handover quality and the induction of new graduates.

work.summary: 24-bed intensive care unit, rotating three-shift pattern.
highlights: Led nursing handover for a 24-bed unit across rotating three-shift cover.
Rewrote the ward's handover checklist after auditing recurring information gaps.
Precepted 14 newly graduated nurses through their first six months.
Sat on the unit's medication-safety group for four years.

work.summary: 18-bed post-anaesthesia care unit serving orthopaedic and abdominal theatres.
highlights: Recovered post-surgical patients across orthopaedic and abdominal lists.
Introduced a structured pain-assessment round at the start of each shift.
Covered triage during the department's winter escalation periods.
Acted as link nurse between recovery and the orthopaedic ward on discharge planning.
Kept the unit's emergency trolley checks and restocking schedule.
Cared for a 6-patient bay on a 28-bed general surgical ward.
Completed the hospital's newly qualified nurse programme.
Volunteered for the ward's wound-care working group in the first year.
Worked evenings and weekends throughout the nursing degree.
Supported residents with dementia through personal care and mealtimes.
